weight_rule: Delete excluded coefficient; divide each surviving baseline weight by the surviving weight sum. No new preference fitting or score modification.
weight_profile_names: Names retain baseline profile identities for paired comparisons; ridership_priority now weights the remaining projected/current load measures, not the excluded current ridership.
selector_rule: Use exactly the same method/profile selectors as baseline v0.6 for every draw
equity_normalization: Freeze baseline v0.6 16-corridor population-SD calibration; retain published City score values
tie_rule: Competition rank intervals with tolerance 1e-12; stable top-k requires worst tied rank <= k
primary_decision_rule: Prefer a corridor meeting >90% top5 inclusion in both baseline and leave-out stress; if the former primary loses that stability, switch to surviving corridor using exact top1/top3/mean-rank evidence. Do not infer the length discrepancy is harmless or officially corrected.
limitations: Six discrete combinations, not 10000 distinct weight vectors or population confidence
City has not confirmed the correct Jane length assignment or actual denominator of the standardized ridership score
Exclusion tests sensitivity to one input, not all possible length-related effects or model misspecification
Remaining model uses speed, projected load, current maximum load, competitiveness and equity; it contains no transfer-connectivity indicator
